in_sanskrit.name: Luckey
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lucky, Fortunate
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Luckey एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Luckey derives from the Sanskrit word ‘लक्ष्य’ (lakshya) which means ‘goal’, ‘target’, or ‘aim’. In Hindu mythology, the gods bestow this name upon their chosen warriors, granting them success in battle and protection from harm. Thus, a child named Luckey is believed to be blessed with good fortune and divine guidance.
